skill.name: ecommerce-product-research
skill.description: 提供商品类目或已有商品资料，整理电商选品候选清单，列出可见价格、匹配条件、入选理由和待核实事项。预算与受众有则提供；已有资料可直接分析，无需 API Key。在线商品查询支持抖音与小红书。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Shortlist products by budget and audience using supplied listings or SocialDataX lookups on Douyin and Xiaohongshu.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts come from Markdown formatting, ordinary configuration references, product identifiers, or readable Chinese text. Online CLI workflows direct users or agents to run an unpinned package with access to service credentials. Shell argument handling and spending controls need safeguards; no evidence of credential exfiltration, an encoded payload, or an attempt to override the audit was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI runs in the credential environment
remediation.suggestion: Replace every floating release reference with a reviewed, integrity-verified CLI version. Require approval before installing it, and run it with only the task-scoped credential and permissions it needs.

remediation.issue: Shell examples do not prescribe safe handling of external inputs
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords, IDs, URLs, and continuation tokens as separate arguments without shell interpolation. Validate product URLs and identifiers against the selected platform.

remediation.issue: Online requests can consume credits without a clear spending limit
remediation.suggestion: State which requests can consume credits and obtain approval for a spending limit before the first paid request. Pause before exceeding that limit, including during retries and after a top-up.

content.value_statement: Product listings can be hard to compare when prices, features, and seller claims vary. This skill organizes visible evidence into a shortlist with reasons and checks for each candidate.
actual_capabilities: Compare supplied product tables or descriptions without a SocialDataX key.
Search one page of Douyin or Xiaohongshu listings by keyword through an authenticated SocialDataX connection.
Apply supported price and service filters on Douyin, or screen Xiaohongshu results by visible price.
Check two or three relevant listings by platform-specific product ID, SKU ID, or product URL.
Produce a Markdown shortlist with visible prices, match reasons, sources, and unresolved checks.
limitations: Live search supports only Douyin and Xiaohongshu. For other platforms, supply listing data instead of a link alone.
Online search requires SocialDataX authentication and may consume credits. Local CLI use also requires Node.js and npm.
The shortlist does not establish market size, actual sales, growth, or profit. Profit estimates require supplied costs and fees.
The workflow does not fetch product reviews or change listings and accounts.

use_cases.title: Screen inventory candidates
use_cases.description: Compare supplier listings against a price ceiling and flag missing costs or product specifications.

use_cases.title: Compare listings for a buyer group
use_cases.description: Find Douyin products for a defined audience and check whether visible seller and service terms match your criteria.

use_cases.title: Prepare a sourced candidate brief
use_cases.description: Summarize a small Xiaohongshu sample and separate listing claims from details that need independent verification.

prompt_templates.title: Compare pasted listings
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Use supplied product data only.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these pasted listings for commuters with a budget of 100 yuan. Show visible prices, reasons to shortlist, and missing details. Do not look up products online.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Douyin category
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Use supported online price filters.
prompt_templates.prompt: On Douyin, shortlist commuter thermoses up to 100 yuan from one page. Ask before any paid calls, then verify the two best matches.

prompt_templates.title: Check Xiaohongshu candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these Xiaohongshu product links for dorm rooms. Ask before paid calls. Screen by visible price, record each source, and flag missing dimensions or return terms.

prompt_templates.title: Build a sourcing brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Combine supplied and live evidence without mixing sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my supplier table with one page of Douyin results for travel organizers. Ask before paid calls and verify the top three available candidates. Separate supplier and platform prices, cite sources, and flag missing costs.

output_examples.input: Illustrative data: Mug A costs 89 yuan and holds 450 ml. Mug B costs 119 yuan. Shortlist mugs under 100 yuan.
output: Mug A: Shortlist at 89 yuan. It meets the budget and lists a 450 ml capacity. Confirm lid seal and return terms.
Mug B: Exclude at 119 yuan because it exceeds the budget.
Source: Supplied listings only. Prices and seller terms were not checked online.

output_examples.input: Summarize a Xiaohongshu desk lamp search when the returned page has no listings with a visible price.
output: Scope: One page of Xiaohongshu desk lamp results.
No listing can be confirmed within budget because the sample has no visible prices.
Next check: Confirm prices from product details or provide listings with visible prices.

best_practices: State your platform, budget, intended buyers, and any required seller or service terms.
Use supplied listings first. Approve a credit budget before requesting paid lookups.
Keep source links or IDs and observation times, and verify terms before buying or sourcing.
anti_patterns: Do not treat search order or a small sample as evidence of platform-wide sales or prices.
Do not paste a SocialDataX key into chat or include it in shared materials.
Do not treat promotional claims or post comments as verified product reviews.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX key?
faq.answer: No key is needed to compare supplied material. Online queries use a configured CLI credential or an authenticated MCP connection.

faq.question: Which platforms support live product lookup?
faq.answer: Live lookup supports Douyin and Xiaohongshu. For other platforms, paste a product table or listing text.

faq.question: Can I apply the same price filter on both platforms?
faq.answer: No. Douyin accepts price filters, while Xiaohongshu results are screened by visible prices after retrieval.

faq.question: Can online searches use paid credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Confirm the scope and credit budget before authorizing online queries.

faq.question: Can the shortlist predict sales or profit?
faq.answer: No. It supports initial screening. A profit estimate requires costs and fees you provide, and rankings do not establish sales.

faq.question: What happens when information is missing?
faq.answer: Missing fields are marked as unavailable. The shortlist identifies specific details to verify and does not invent values.
